physicalEvidence.status: Preliminary current IHMC/UWF collaborative hardware RL,10trials; individual lab access unknown
physicalEvidence.summary: Complete March 2026 paper trains an asymmetric PPO actor-critic in Isaac Lab with balance metrics as privileged critic inputs/rewards. A proprioception-only actor sends joint-position targets to low-level PD control on real Unitree H1-2 at 50Hz. All10 tested supine/seated/kneeling/crouched initializations reached upright, but3trials had post-recovery high-frequency oscillations prompting safety intervention. The 93.4% figure is simulation, not physical success; hardware is preliminary. Sevil is an explicitly UWF-affiliated coauthor in the full manuscript; lead Poddar names Griffin as advisor. Physical20 for verified joint-program collaboration, without claiming Sevil-exclusive hardware or primary advising.
